description: This source file defines a custom HttpServlet, ModuleServlet, which handles incoming HTTP requests to route them to specific module servlets within the OpenMRS framework. It includes logic for parsing URL path info to identify the target module and servlet, and a nested class SimpleServletConfig to provide servlet configuration details.

classes.name: ModuleServlet
classes.description: A custom HttpServlet that routes requests to specific module servlets based on URL path info. Contains a nested static class for servlet configuration.

classes.name: ModuleServlet.SimpleServletConfig
classes.description: An implementation of ServletConfig used to initialize module servlets with context and parameters.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Overrides the HttpServlet service method to parse the request URL, identify the target module and servlet, and delegate processing to the appropriate servlet.

methods.name: getServletName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current servlet configuration.

methods.name: getServletContext
methods.description: Returns the ServletContext for this servlet configuration.

methods.name: getInitParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific initialization parameter by name.

methods.name: getInitParameterNames
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of all initialization parameter names.
